messages:
maria: Heads-up: GateMesh (ISV) wants a joint "Certified for Redwood Gateway" listing + marketplace card. Targeting a soft launch in 10 days. Need a compact tech checklist, images, and a short perf clip.

sandeep: What exact artifacts do they need from us?

maria: 2 screenshots, SVG icon, 1-sentence eng blurb, quickstart snippet, and a small perf clip (A100 vs V100). Also signed logo permission.

olivia: Marketing can draft the card + brief blog. pls give a one-line eng quote (30-50 chars).

kai: Eng quote suggestion: "LangChain-native connector for Redwood Gateway". Will build demo image with LangChain + LlamaIndex sample.

raj: Testing note: disable persistent KV during demo and ship an embeddings-only sample to avoid token spikes.

chloe: Legal: need non-endorsement clause and logo agreement signed before publish.

partner-ops: HW available for perf shoot Fri 09:00 UTC (A100 booked). booking ID PB-5902. Avoid Thurs 02:00-04:00 UTC maintenance window.

maria: Owners: marketing (olivia) for assets, eng (kai) demo image + perf clip, qa (raj) smoke test, partnerships (maria) to collect signed logo form, legal (chloe) for wording. Dry-run Tues 18:00 UTC. Updates in-thread only.
